briefing.summary: Dive 3,800 m to the wreck of RMS Titanic, lost on 15 April 1912. Find and scan the bow and stern sections, which lie about 600 m apart on the seabed, then survey the boiler field and debris near the stern.
facts: The wreck was found on 1 September 1985 by a French–American team led by Jean-Louis Michel and Robert Ballard.
The ship broke apart as it sank. The bow faces roughly north, and the stern turned around as it fell, so its rear end points back at the bow.
You start at the surface about 2 km north-north-west of the bow. Head south-south-east (about 150°) and descend.
The hull shapes are artist's reconstructions at the real coordinates. The open bathymetry is too coarse to show the wreck itself.
hazards: Total darkness: sunlight fades out within the top few hundred metres, and below that only your lights work.
Crushing pressure: about 380 atmospheres at the seabed. Your Class B hull is rated to 4,500 m.
Fragile, collapsing structure: decks and railings are still falling. Keep a respectful distance and do not touch.
Deep currents sweep the site and stir up sediment that reduces visibility.
briefing.memorial_note: The Titanic is the final resting place of about 1,500 people who died on 15 April 1912. Please explore it as you would a memorial. The game has no salvage, collection or loot of any kind; you observe and learn only, in keeping with the international agreement that protects the site.

objectives.title: Locate and scan the bow section
objectives.hint: The reconstructed bow rests upright at the north end of Titanic's wreck area, around 3,790 m.

objectives.title: Locate and scan the stern section
objectives.hint: The reconstructed, damaged stern lies roughly 700 m south of the bow, around 3,795 m.

objectives.title: Survey the boiler field
objectives.hint: The illustrative boiler-field marker is east of the stern in the debris area, around 3,795 m.

objectives.title: Pause at the memorial plaque site on the stern
objectives.hint: The illustrative memorial-plaque marker is at the stern, south of the bow near 3,790 m; its exact in-game placement is not surveyed.
